title: Option, Result, ? and serde

examples.name: serde_demo.rs

exercise.prompt: Write `parse_positive(input: &str) -> Result<i32, String>` returning Ok(n) for positive integers and Err with a clear message otherwise; print both outcomes for "42" and "-7".
hints: Then check n > 0, mapping failures into Err(String).
The ? operator can chain parse directly inside.

questions.prompt: `expr?` inside fn returning Result does what on Err?
